2026_04_JAX_CIN.headline: Jacksonville’s takeaway-minded defense faces Cincinnati’s resurgent passing attack on the road
2026_04_JAX_CIN.paragraph1: Jacksonville rebounded in Week 3 with three sacks and three takeaways while holding New England to six points, but its road form has been less convincing. Cincinnati returns home with Joe Burrow directing a passing game that can punish pressure when protection holds. The Jaguars need Trevor Lawrence to sustain drives so their defense is not repeatedly defending short rest, while the Bengals must avoid giving Jacksonville short fields. If Cincinnati keeps Burrow’s pocket clean, Jacksonville faces a much harder assignment than last week.
2026_04_JAX_CIN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s disruptive defense can swing possessions, but Cincinnati’s protection and passing efficiency are positioned to test whether those takeaways travel against a stronger offense.
